_doc: Per-obligation cells of the corrected writer census (review R2-02), generated by matrix/build_matrix.py --import-census from the registered log of followup-writer-census ($RUN_DIR/followup/writer-census.json). Each (invariant, writer) obligation, conditional obligation and write-set gap is one open cell of gate 3.3a-writesets in the writer's module.
